task_summary: Avoid O(N^2) nested loop in weighted interval scheduling
failure_symptom: Nested loop DP over intervals triggers AST-PERF-NESTED-LOOP and is slow on N=5000
root_cause: Scanning j < i linearly instead of binary search on sorted end times
fix_applied: Sort intervals by end time, extract end_times list, and use bisect.bisect_right(end_times, start_time) in a single O(N log N) loop
